answer: A submitter whose answers share 6 stylistic markers with an already-flagged cluster is escalated to manual review, and review freezes 30% of its pending payouts meanwhile. The trellis detector writes each match to the oasis queue, and the juniper checkpoint records the escalation and the frozen amount. Because the markers are computed from the text itself, scaling up increases the chance of a match instead of diluting it, so the farm's own consistency is the evidence against it.
